_doc: Small single trees for the dense forest canopy of the adventure map (bead xaj.26, docs/art/classes/trees.md): about 0.35-0.6 cell wide at native display size, never downscaled or mirrored. One generate-image-v2 call per species at 48x48 returns 25 candidates of a mixed subject; the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Layers: style, light, class-tree, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.concept: GRASS CONIFERS
recipes.subject: Subject: one small evergreen conifer, each image a different one of these: a slim pointed spruce, a fir with three stacked layers of drooping branches, a narrow pine with a blunt tip, a young bushy spruce. Dark cool blue-green #2e6b5a, shadow #1d4a40, lit edges #4f9a7a on the left side, a short brown trunk #5a3a24. Narrow: about half of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.

recipes.concept: GRASS BROADLEAF
recipes.subject: Subject: one small round deciduous tree in summer, each image a different one of these: a round oak with a lumpy crown, a lime tree with an oval crown, a beech with two big leaf lobes, an ash with a loose crown. Fresh leaf green #4f8f3a, shadow #2f5f2a, light #7fb455 on the left side, a short brown trunk #5a3a24. About two thirds of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.

recipes.concept: GRASS AUTUMN
recipes.subject: Subject: one small round deciduous tree in autumn, each image a different one of these: an orange maple #e07a2a with shadow #a24a1c, a golden yellow birch #e6bf3e with shadow #a8841e and a white trunk, a red-orange oak #cc5a2a with shadow #8a3418, a yellow-green lime #b8b840 with shadow #7a7a2a. A short brown trunk #5a3a24. About two thirds of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.

recipes.concept: JUNGLE TREES
recipes.subject: Subject: one small jungle tree, each image a different one of these: a palm with a gently curved trunk and five broad drooping fronds, a broadleaf jungle tree with a round dense crown, a banana plant with a few huge paddle leaves, a tree fern with a crown of feathery fronds. Deep bluish greens #2f7a52, shadow #1e5040, light #5aa86c on the left side, trunks brown #6a4a2a. About two thirds of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.

recipes.concept: STEPPE TREES
recipes.subject: Subject: one small lone steppe tree, each image a different one of these: a squat oak with a round olive crown, a birch with a white trunk and a light airy yellow-green crown, a wind-bent elm with a lopsided crown, a wild pear with a small round crown. Dusty olive green #7a8a3a, shadow #525e28, dry yellow-green light #a8a850 on the left side, trunks grey-brown #6a5236. About two thirds of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.

recipes.concept: BADLANDS SCRUB
recipes.subject: Subject: one small desert scrub tree, each image a different one of these: a twisted juniper with a dense bushy dark blue-green crown, a mesquite with a flat feathery olive crown, a gnarled dry tree with three clumps of grey-green leaves, a short desert pine with a flat top. Leaves dark sage #4a6a52, shadow #2e4436, light #7a9a6a on the left side, twisted trunks red-brown #7a4a2e. About two thirds of the image wide and most of the image tall.

recipes.concept: WASTELAND DEAD TREES
recipes.subject: Subject: one small dead tree after a wildfire, chunky and simple, each image a different one of these: a charred trunk with a few thick broken branches, a grey dead snag with a split top, a burnt pine with a few ash-grey needle tufts, a twisted bare tree with stubby limbs. Charcoal #2e2a28, ash grey #77706a, light grey #a49c94 on the left side, one tiny ember orange #c8642a crack at most. About half of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.

recipes.concept: WASTELAND DEAD TREES, FULL CROWNS
recipes.subject: Subject: one small dead tree after a wildfire with a full bushy crown of many short bare twisted branches, chunky and simple, the crown as wide as a living tree's, each image a different one of these: a dead oak with a round tangle of grey branches, a charred pine with drooping black needle tufts, a dead tree with a few dry brown leaves left in its crown, a twisted dead willow. Charcoal #2e2a28, ash grey #77706a, light grey #a49c94 on the left side, dry brown leaves #7a5a3a. About two thirds of the image wide and nearly the full image tall.

recipes.concept: GRASS BROADLEAF, DEEP GREEN

recipes.concept: BADLANDS JUNIPERS, DENSE OLIVE CROWNS
